popover.domFallback: [popover]: appendto element missing from dom, falling back to body
popover.serverSideCall: [popover]: toggle method triggered on server-side, skipping action.
popover.methodsDeclarative: [popover]: { method }() called in declarative mode. use v-model:open instead.
popover.triggererElementNull: [popover] triggerer prop is set, but element is null. check if the target element is mounted.
popover.imperativeNotice:
[popover] imperative mode notice:
• "triggerer" prop is ignored in imperative mode.
• fix: pass element to methods: ref.toggle(elementref)
• or: add "open" prop to switch to declarative mode.
popover.declarativeError:
[popover] declarative mode error:
• "open" prop is provided (v-model:open), but "triggerer" is missing.
• fix: add :triggerer="elementref" for positioning.
• or: remove "open" prop to use imperative mode with ref.toggle().
